```{r initiate}
rm(list = ls())
# 0a.Declare root directory, folder location and load essential stuff
project.folder = paste0(print(here::here()), '/')
source(paste0(project.folder, 'create_folder_structure.R'))
source(paste0(functions.folder, 'script_initiate.R'))
```

# 1. Load daily panel and aggregate to weekly

```{r load-aggregate}
# 1a.Load the daily zone × date timeseries (IND+INR filtered, CSLT excluded)
daily <- readRDS(paste0(objects_folder, "fishnet_timeseries_daily_modeling.RDS"))
setDT(daily)
setkey(daily, zone_id, date)

# 1b.Unit conversion guard (m → mm). Skipped if already converted.
if (max(daily$runoff, na.rm = TRUE) < 1) {
  daily[, runoff        := runoff        * 1000]
  daily[, precipitation := precipitation * 1000]
}

# 1c.ISO week identifier
daily[, week_id := paste0(lubridate::isoyear(date), "-W",
                          formatC(lubridate::isoweek(date), width = 2, flag = "0"))]
daily[, dow := lubridate::wday(date, week_start = 1)]   # Monday=1; for bird anchoring

# 1d.Aggregate per zone × week: means for state variables, sums for fluxes
weekly <- daily[, .(
  week_start          = min(date),
  week_end            = max(date),
  year                = lubridate::isoyear(min(date)),
  month               = lubridate::month(min(date)),
  outbreak_binary     = as.integer(any(outbreak_binary == 1)),
  outbreak_count      = sum(outbreak_count, na.rm = TRUE),
  # Means (state variables)
  temperature         = mean(temperature,         na.rm = TRUE),
  soil_moisture       = mean(soil_moisture,       na.rm = TRUE),
  snow_cover          = mean(snow_cover,          na.rm = TRUE),
  wind_speed          = mean(wind_speed,          na.rm = TRUE),
  anseriformes        = {                                     # Monday-anchored (weekly anchor, no smearing)
    m_vals <- .SD[dow == 1, anseriformes]
    if (length(m_vals) > 0 && !is.na(m_vals[1])) m_vals[1] else first(.SD$anseriformes)
  },
  # Sums (flux variables)
  precipitation       = sum(precipitation,        na.rm = TRUE),
  runoff              = sum(runoff,               na.rm = TRUE)
), by = .(zone_id, week_id)]

setkey(weekly, zone_id, week_start)

# 1e.log1p the right-skewed exposures (match daily pipeline)
weekly[, runoff        := log1p(runoff)]
weekly[, precipitation := log1p(precipitation)]
weekly[, snow_cover    := snow_cover / 100]                       # already 0-1 fraction, no log1p needed
weekly[, anseriformes  := log1p(anseriformes)]

# 1f.z-scale all 6 exposures across all zone-weeks
exp_vars <- c("runoff", "soil_moisture", "temperature",
              "precipitation", "wind_speed", "snow_cover", "anseriformes")
for (v in exp_vars) {
  weekly[[v]] <- as.numeric(scale(weekly[[v]]))
}

cat("Weekly panel: ", nrow(weekly), " zone-weeks across ", uniqueN(weekly$zone_id), " zones\n", sep = "")
cat("Case-weeks in 2022 (IND+INR only): ",
    weekly[outbreak_binary == 1 & year == 2022, .N], "\n", sep = "")
```

# 2. Build weekly lag matrix (lag 0–4 weeks per variable)

```{r weekly-lag-matrix}
# For each (zone, week) row, compute lag 0 (this week), 1, 2, 3, 4 (4 weeks back).
# shift() works within zone because key is (zone_id, week_start) and weeks are
# consecutive (no gaps in the daily panel).
MAX_LAG_WK <- 4

for (v in exp_vars) {
  new_names <- paste0(v, "_Lag", 0:MAX_LAG_WK)
  weekly[, (new_names) := shift(.SD[[1]], n = 0:MAX_LAG_WK, type = "lag"),
         by = zone_id, .SDcols = v]
}
```

# 3. PATH A — original design: 1:4 unidirectional weekly (controls at W-1, W-2, W-3, W-4)

```{r path-A-build}
case_weeks_A <- weekly[outbreak_binary == 1 & year == 2022,
                       .(zone_id, week_id, week_start)]
cat("case-weeks (1:4 unidirectional): ", nrow(case_weeks_A), "\n", sep = "")

# For each case (zone, week_W), pull 4 controls at week_W minus 1..4 weeks
build_path_A <- function(case_zd) {
  rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(case_zd)), function(i) {
    z  <- case_zd$zone_id[i]
    ws <- case_zd$week_start[i]
    sid <- paste0("A_", z, "_", as.character(ws))
    # Case row
    case_row <- weekly[zone_id == z & week_start == ws]
    case_row[, `:=`(stratum_id = sid, case_control = "case")]
    # 4 control rows at W-7, W-14, W-21, W-28 days
    ctrl_dates <- ws - c(7, 14, 21, 28)
    ctrl_rows  <- weekly[zone_id == z & week_start %in% ctrl_dates]
    ctrl_rows[, `:=`(stratum_id = sid, case_control = "control",
                     outbreak_binary = 0L)]
    rbind(case_row, ctrl_rows)
  }))
}

cc_A <- build_path_A(case_weeks_A)

# Drop strata that didn't get the full 1:4 set
strata_full_A <- cc_A[, .N, by = stratum_id][N == 5, stratum_id]
cc_A <- cc_A[stratum_id %in% strata_full_A]
cat("Strata retained (1:4 complete): ", uniqueN(cc_A$stratum_id),
    " | rows: ", nrow(cc_A), "\n", sep = "")
```

```{r path-A-fit}
# Crossbases (weekly lag 0–4, ns df=2 — matching the original spec)
cb_runoff_A <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(cc_A[, paste0("runoff_Lag", 0:MAX_LAG_WK), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, MAX_LAG_WK), argvar = list(fun = "lin"),
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 2)
)
cb_soil_moisture_A <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(cc_A[, paste0("soil_moisture_Lag", 0:MAX_LAG_WK), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, MAX_LAG_WK), argvar = list(fun = "lin"),
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 2)
)
cb_temperature_A <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(cc_A[, paste0("temperature_Lag", 0:MAX_LAG_WK), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, MAX_LAG_WK), argvar = list(fun = "lin"),
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 2)
)
cb_precipitation_A <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(cc_A[, paste0("precipitation_Lag", 0:MAX_LAG_WK), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, MAX_LAG_WK), argvar = list(fun = "lin"),
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 2)
)
cb_wind_speed_A <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(cc_A[, paste0("wind_speed_Lag", 0:MAX_LAG_WK), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, MAX_LAG_WK), argvar = list(fun = "lin"),
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 2)
)
cb_snow_cover_A <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(cc_A[, paste0("snow_cover_Lag", 0:MAX_LAG_WK), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, MAX_LAG_WK), argvar = list(fun = "lin"),
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 2)
)
cb_anseriformes_A <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(cc_A[, paste0("anseriformes_Lag", 0:MAX_LAG_WK), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, MAX_LAG_WK), argvar = list(fun = "lin"),
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 2)
)

model_A <- clogit(
  outbreak_binary ~
    cb_runoff_A + cb_soil_moisture_A + cb_temperature_A +
    cb_precipitation_A + cb_wind_speed_A + cb_snow_cover_A +
    cb_anseriformes_A +
    strata(stratum_id),
  method = "efron", data = cc_A
)
saveRDS(model_A, paste0(models_folder, "weekly_model_pathA.RDS"))
print(summary(model_A))
```

# 4. PATH B — time-stratified weekly (zone × year × month)

```{r path-B-build}
case_weeks_B <- weekly[outbreak_binary == 1 & year == 2022,
                       .(zone_id, week_id, week_start, year, month)]
cat("time-stratified case weeks: ", nrow(case_weeks_B), "\n", sep = "")

build_path_B <- function(case_zd) {
  rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(case_zd)), function(i) {
    z   <- case_zd$zone_id[i]
    yr  <- case_zd$year[i]
    mn  <- case_zd$month[i]
    ws  <- case_zd$week_start[i]
    sid <- paste0("B_", z, "_", yr, "-", formatC(mn, width = 2, flag = "0"))
    # All weeks in zone × year × month
    stratum_rows <- weekly[zone_id == z & year == yr & month == mn]
    stratum_rows[, stratum_id := sid]
    stratum_rows[, case_control := fifelse(week_start == ws, "case", "control")]
    stratum_rows[case_control == "control", outbreak_binary := 0L]
    stratum_rows
  }))
}

cc_B <- build_path_B(case_weeks_B)

# Drop strata that don't have both a case and ≥1 control
strata_keep_B <- cc_B[, .(n_case = sum(case_control == "case"),
                          n_ctrl = sum(case_control == "control")),
                      by = stratum_id][n_case >= 1 & n_ctrl >= 1, stratum_id]
cc_B <- cc_B[stratum_id %in% strata_keep_B]

# Some strata may have multiple case-weeks (rare but possible if same zone had
# outbreaks in 2+ weeks of the same month). Treat each case-week separately by
# de-duplicating: collapse to one case row per stratum (we already did this via
# the per-case loop above, but the inner stratum_rows pulls all rows in the
# month including the other case-week if present).
cat("time-stratified — strata: ", uniqueN(cc_B$stratum_id),
    " | rows: ", nrow(cc_B),
    " | cases: ", sum(cc_B$outbreak_binary == 1),
    " | controls: ", sum(cc_B$outbreak_binary == 0),
    "\n", sep = "")
```

```{r path-B-fit}
cb_precipitation_B <- crossbasis(

cb_wind_speed_B <- crossbasis(

cb_snow_cover_B <- crossbasis(

model_B <- clogit(

  method = "efron", data = cc_B
)
saveRDS(model_B, paste0(models_folder, "weekly_model_pathB.RDS"))
print(summary(model_B))
```

# 5. Extract cumulative ORs across the 0–4 week window for each path

```{r cumulative-extraction}
extract_ors <- function(model, cb_objs, predictor_names, path_label) {
  lag_seq    <- 0:MAX_LAG_WK
  lag_basis  <- do.call(dlnm::onebasis,
                        c(list(x = lag_seq), attr(cb_objs[[1]], "arglag")))
  contrast   <- 0.5 * colSums(lag_basis)

  beta <- coef(model); V <- vcov(model)

  rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(cb_objs), function(i) {
    prefix <- names(cb_objs)[i]
    cols   <- grep(paste0("^", prefix, "v"), names(beta))
    b      <- beta[cols]; Vsub <- V[cols, cols]
    lo     <- as.numeric(contrast %*% b)
    se     <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(contrast) %*% Vsub %*% contrast))
    data.table(
      Path      = path_label,
      Predictor = predictor_names[i],
      OR_CI     = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
                          exp(lo), exp(lo - 1.96 * se), exp(lo + 1.96 * se))
    )
  }))
}

cb_list_A <- list(
  cb_runoff_A         = cb_runoff_A,
  cb_soil_moisture_A  = cb_soil_moisture_A,
  cb_temperature_A    = cb_temperature_A,
  cb_precipitation_A  = cb_precipitation_A,
  cb_wind_speed_A     = cb_wind_speed_A,
  cb_snow_cover_A     = cb_snow_cover_A,
  cb_anseriformes_A   = cb_anseriformes_A
)
cb_list_B <- list(
  cb_runoff_B         = cb_runoff_B,
  cb_soil_moisture_B  = cb_soil_moisture_B,
  cb_temperature_B    = cb_temperature_B,
  cb_precipitation_B  = cb_precipitation_B,
  cb_wind_speed_B     = cb_wind_speed_B,
  cb_snow_cover_B     = cb_snow_cover_B,
  cb_anseriformes_B   = cb_anseriformes_B
)
pretty_names <- c("Runoff", "Soil Moisture", "Temperature",
                  "Precipitation", "Wind Speed", "Snow Cover", "Anseriformes")

res_A <- extract_ors(model_A, cb_list_A, pretty_names,
                     "1:4 unidirectional (original design)")
res_B <- extract_ors(model_B, cb_list_B, pretty_names,
                     "Time-stratified: time-stratified (zone × year × month)")
```

# 6. Weekly lag-specific (per-week) ORs and weekly window OR

```{r weekly-lag-specific}
extract_per_lag <- function(model, cb_objs, predictor_names, path_label) {
  beta <- coef(model); V <- vcov(model)

  rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(cb_objs), function(i) {
    prefix <- names(cb_objs)[i]
    cols   <- grep(paste0("^", prefix, "v"), names(beta))
    b      <- beta[cols]; Vsub <- V[cols, cols]
    lag_basis <- do.call(dlnm::onebasis,
                         c(list(x = 0:MAX_LAG_WK), attr(cb_objs[[i]], "arglag")))
    # Per-lag OR at +0.5 SD
    rbindlist(lapply(0:MAX_LAG_WK, function(k) {
      contrast_k <- 0.5 * lag_basis[k + 1, ]
      lo  <- as.numeric(contrast_k %*% b)
      se  <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(contrast_k) %*% Vsub %*% contrast_k))
      data.table(
        Path      = path_label,
        Predictor = predictor_names[i],
        Lag       = paste0("Lag ", k, " wk"),
        OR_CI     = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
                            exp(lo), exp(lo - 1.96 * se), exp(lo + 1.96 * se))
      )
    }))
  }))
}

lag_A <- extract_per_lag(model_A, cb_list_A, pretty_names, "1:4 unidirectional")
lag_B <- extract_per_lag(model_B, cb_list_B, pretty_names, "time-stratified")

wide_A <- dcast(lag_A, Predictor ~ Lag, value.var = "OR_CI")
wide_B <- dcast(lag_B, Predictor ~ Lag, value.var = "OR_CI")
print(wide_A); print(wide_B)
```

# 7. Side-by-side cumulative table

```{r side-by-side}
combined_cum <- merge(
  setnames(copy(res_A)[, .(Predictor, OR_CI)], "OR_CI", "1:4 unidirectional (unidirectional)"),
  setnames(copy(res_B)[, .(Predictor, OR_CI)], "OR_CI", "time-stratified (time-stratified)"),
  by = "Predictor"
)
print(combined_cum)

ft_cum <- combined_cum %>%
  flextable() %>%
  fontsize(size = 11, part = "all") %>%
  autofit() %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  theme_booktabs()

doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft_cum) %>%
  body_add_par(
    paste0("Weekly case-crossover cumulative ORs (per +0.5 SD, lag 0-4 weeks) for the primary 6-variable DLNM after CSLT exclusion. 1:4 unidirectional: original design with 1:4 unidirectional matching (4 controls at week-1, -2, -3, -4 before each case week). Time-stratified: time-stratified matching (zone × year × calendar month strata) that removes seasonal-trend confounding. ",
           "N cases (1:4 unidirectional) = ", uniqueN(cc_A$stratum_id),
           "; N cases (time-stratified) = ", uniqueN(cc_B$stratum_id), "."),
    style = "Normal"
  )
print(doc, target = paste0(tables_main_folder, "Table_Weekly_Primary_AB.docx"))

# Per-week tables
ft_lag_A <- wide_A %>%
  flextable() %>%
  fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") %>%
  autofit() %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  theme_booktabs()
ft_lag_B <- wide_B %>%
  flextable() %>%
  fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") %>%
  autofit() %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  theme_booktabs()

doc2 <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_par("A. 1:4 unidirectional (original design)", style = "Normal") %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft_lag_A) %>%
  body_add_par("", style = "Normal") %>%
  body_add_par("B. time-stratified — time-stratified", style = "Normal") %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft_lag_B) %>%
  body_add_par(
    "Per-lag-week ORs (per +0.5 SD) from the weekly primary case-crossover DLNM (lag 0-4 weeks, ns df=2). CSLT-linked events excluded throughout.",
    style = "Normal"
  )
print(doc2, target = paste0(tables_main_folder, "Table_Weekly_Primary_PerLag.docx"))
```
